purpose: Read-only preflight packet for live-runtime or external-runtime actions. This spec defines universal checks only; concrete commands, service names, wait windows, and verification contours must come from governed project data.

checks.question: Is live-runtime validation explicitly requested or approved by the operator?
checks.why: External runtime actions can create live-data noise and should not be inferred from ordinary code verification.

checks.question: Has the active project verification policy been resolved from governed project data?
checks.why: Runtime contours, commands, service names, and wait windows are project knowledge, not universal MCP behavior.

checks.question: If this action follows a restart, has the project-defined stabilization or stale-owner window been respected?
checks.why: Immediate checks after restart can falsely report failure while runtime ownership or health state is still stabilizing.

checks.question: Will the result be recorded as live diagnostic evidence rather than formal isolated test verification?
checks.why: Live diagnostic exploitation complements synthetic tests but does not replace the project-approved verification contour.

next_safe_action: Review this preflight packet, expand relevant law/cue refs if needed, then perform the live-runtime action only when operator intent and project policy are clear.
